text:
lena_marketing: quick note  inbound HubSpot leads are queuing in enrichment and not hitting Salesforce within SLA (~5-10m). SDRs getting delayed. :worried:

yoav_ops: saw a small spike during the 11:20-11:45 PST ramp. enrichment p99 jumped; rr-claim backlog increased.

carmen_sales: current SLA assign <2m, SF create <5m. right now ~11% are >5m.

ash_engineering: pipeline: hs webhook -> enrichment async -> rr-claim -> sf-create. when enrichment retries pile up rr-claim waits on enriched payloads. quick mitigation: enable TTL fallback after 75s to send a minimal payload to SF (tag `enrich_skip=true`). also bump enrichment workers for the window.

lena_marketing: can we gate fallback for peak window only and tag events so SDRs can filter?

yoav_ops: yes. plan: 30m canary during peak. dashboard tile for `enrich_skip` and an alert for enrichment.queue > 400.

ops-bot: deploy started by yoav_ops at 5012346800 :rocket:

ash_engineering: deployed. fallback enabled.

lena_marketing: initial numbers: >5m assigns dropped from 11% -> 2% within 5m. i'll notify SDR leads: "Temporarily enabling minimal handoff during peak; you'll see `enrich_skip=true` on some records."

carmen_sales: thanks. next steps: ash to open RFC for rr fairness + graceful degrade; yoav to add alert; lena to send comms.

yoav_ops: alert `enrichment.queue.count > 400 for 5m` -> page on-call.

lena_marketing: thanks team, follow-up in marketing-ops tomorrow.
